status.description: Overall verdict. 'blocked' means the task could not be performed at all, as opposed to a check having failed.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what was examined, what was found, and the single most important conclusion.

checks.description: One entry per expectation that was examined, in the order examined.

name.description: Short identifier for the expectation, e.g. 'empty-submit-shows-error'.

verdict.description: Use 'unclear' when the check could not be conclusively evaluated.

expected.description: What the expectation was, stated concretely.

actual.description: What was actually observed, with concrete detail (text seen, selector, URL, state).

evidence.description: Absolute paths of saved artifacts supporting this verdict. A 'fail' verdict requires at least one screenshot path.

artifacts.description: Absolute paths of every file produced by this run.

blockers.description: Anything that prevented a check from being performed: missing permissions, auth failures, absent dependencies. Empty when nothing blocked.
